title: Carryover credits.
bodyText: No credit hours earned during a single renewal cycle may be carried over and counted towards satisfaction of the credit hour requirements for a following renewal cycle for the same license.
bodyHtml: [§431:9A-155]  Carryover credits.  No credit hours earned during a single renewal cycle may be carried over and counted towards satisfaction of the credit hour requirements for a following renewal cycle for the same license. [L 2003, c 55, pt of §1]
